column1: DFHack help: Farms that span multiple biomes are handled correctly: any crop that can grow in any of the biomes covered by the farm's tiles may be assigned to that farm.

column1: DFHack help: Individual farm plots can be excluded from autofarm management via the controls that appear on the farm plot information sheet. That sheet also provides a shortcut to gui/autofarm, a convenient UI for setting crop thresholds and enabling or disabling autofarm.
column2: 可以通过农田信息面板上的控件，将单块农田排除在自动种植管理之外。该面板还提供 gui/autofarm 的入口，可在此图形界面中设置作物阈值，并启用或停用自动种植。

column1: DFHack help: Some plants produce usable growth items (such as fruits, leaves, or bulbs) when processed or gathered. These products normally count toward the plant's threshold together with the plant items themselves, but you can also assign a threshold to a specific growth product with the "<plant>:<growth>" syntax. A plant is grown while either its pooled stock or any of its assigned growth products is below the corresponding threshold.
column2: 有些植物在加工或采集时会产出可用的生长物，例如果实、叶子或鳞茎。这些产物通常与植物本身一起计入该植物的库存阈值；也可以用 "<plant>:<growth>" 语法，为指定生长物单独设置阈值。只要合并库存或任一单独设置阈值的生长物库存低于对应阈值，就会继续种植该植物。

DFHack help: Manage autofarm crop thresholds.
column2: 管理自动种植的作物库存阈值。

column1: DFHack help: This is the configuration interface for the autofarm plugin. It lists all farmable crops along with their current stock counts and their assigned thresholds, and allows you to set individual thresholds, reset them to the default, set the default threshold, or set the threshold for all crops at once. Autofarm itself can also be enabled or disabled from this interface.
column2: 这是 autofarm 插件的配置界面。界面列出所有可种植作物，以及各自的当前库存和设定阈值。可以为单种作物设置阈值、恢复默认阈值、修改默认阈值，或一次为所有作物设置阈值；也可以在此启用或停用自动种植。

column1: DFHack help: Crops that produce usable growth items (such as fruits, leaves, or bulbs) list those products indented beneath the crop. A growth product counts toward its crop's pooled threshold unless you assign it a threshold of its own, in which case the crop is grown until both the pool and that product's stock meet their thresholds.
column2: 对于能产出可用生长物的作物，例如果实、叶子或鳞茎，这些产物会缩进列在作物下方。生长物默认计入所属作物的合并库存阈值；如果为其单独设置阈值，则会持续种植，直到合并库存和该生长物库存都达到各自的阈值。

column1: DFHack help: The bottom of the window shows how many farm plots are currently excluded from autofarm management. Individual farm plots can be excluded (or re-included) via the controls that appear on the farm plot information sheet.
column2: 窗口底部显示当前有多少块农田未纳入自动种植管理。可以通过农田信息面板上的控件，将单块农田排除或重新纳入管理。
